question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?
sql:
WITH ordered_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as rn
    FROM activity_log
),
sequences AS (
    SELECT 
        a.rn,
        b.rn + 1 as rn2,
        c.rn + 2 as rn3,
        a.session,
        a.path as path1,
        b.path as path2,
        c.path as path3
    FROM ordered_visits a
    JOIN ordered_visits b ON a.session = b.session AND a.rn = b.rn + 1
    JOIN ordered_visits c ON b.session = c.session AND b.rn = c.rn + 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT path3 as third_page
FROM sequences
WHERE LOWER(path1) = '/detail' AND LOWER(path2) = '/detail'
ORDER BY path3
